login.label: My account
login.h1: Log in or create an account
login.lede: Enter your email and we will send you a six-digit code. If you do not have an account, we create it once you have entered the code. There is no password to remember.
login.raekke1: **Orders** · Delivery week, delivery day and what you ordered
login.raekke2: **Saved designs** · Open them in the designer and keep working
login.uden: Do you have an order confirmation? The link in the email shows your order without logging in.
login.emailHjaelp: Use the email you ordered with or saved a design with.
login.note: We use your email for codes and messages about your orders. You will not get newsletters. Our privacy policy is in Danish.
login.noteLead: We use your email for codes and messages about your orders, and we may contact you about a quote for what you save. You will not get newsletters. Our privacy policy is in Danish.
login.fejlLoft: We have sent several codes to that address in a short time. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
login.fejlDoegn: Too many wrong codes have been entered for that email today, so we have closed login with it until tomorrow. If you have an order, the link in your order confirmation still works. If it is urgent, call +45 42 42 26 84.
login.fejlRobot: We could not confirm that you are a person. Try again in a moment.
login.fejl: We could not send the code. Try again in a moment, or call us on +45 42 42 26 84.
login.udloebet: You have been logged out. Log in again to continue where you left off.
login.loggetUdAlle: You are logged out on all devices.
login.slettet: Your account has been deleted. We have sent a confirmation to {email}.
kode.h1: Enter the code from the email
kode.lede: We have sent a six-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
kode.hjaelp: The email comes from Nem Inventar with the code in the subject, normally within a minute. If you cannot see it, check your spam folder.
kode.vent: You can ask for a new code in {n} sec.
kode.nyKlar: You can now ask for a new code.
kode.nySendt: We have sent a new code. The old one no longer works.
kode.forkert: The code does not match. Check the six digits, and use the code from the latest email.
kode.spaerret: The code is blocked after five wrong attempts. Ask for a new code.
kode.udloebet: The code has expired. Ask for a new one and we will send it straight away.
best.kunDansk: The order page is in Danish.
best.status.frist: Delivery week will be confirmed by {dag}
best.status.fristOver: The delivery week has not been confirmed yet
best.status.ugeOver: Delivery in week {nr} has not been agreed yet
best.tom: Your orders appear here when you have bought in the designer.
best.tomHjaelp: If you ordered with another email, log in with that one. If you have an agreement based on a quote from us, your contact person keeps you updated.
design.kol: Design · Saved · Price when you saved
design.note: The price is the one the designer showed when you saved. You pay the price the designer shows on the day you order.
design.udenLoginHjaelp: Open it in the designer and save again to give it an image and a name.
design.linkKopieret: The link has been copied. Anyone with the link can open the design.
design.tom: The designs you save in the designer appear here. Press "Save design" when you have drawn something you want to come back to.
konto.emailHjaelp: If you want to use another email, write to tilbud@neminventar.dk and we will move your orders with you.
konto.logUdAlleTekst: On all devices, including this one.
konto.logUdAlleSpoerg: Log out on all devices? You will need a new code to log in again.
konto.slet1: When you delete the account, we delete your login and your saved designs. This cannot be undone. Room images are deleted 12 months after they were made.
konto.slet2: We have to keep your orders for five years after the end of the financial year. Danish bookkeeping law requires it. An order we have not delivered yet will still be delivered, and the link in your order confirmation still works.
konto.slet3: If you later create an account with the same email, your orders will be there again.
konto.sletKode: Enter the code from the email to delete the account. It is valid for 10 minutes.
noscript: This page cannot be shown because JavaScript is turned off in your browser. Call +45 42 42 26 84 or write to tilbud@neminventar.dk, and we will tell you how far your order has come.
nede: We cannot show your orders right now. Nothing has happened to them. Try again in a moment, or call +45 42 42 26 84.
side.nede: We cannot show My account right now. Try again in a moment. If you have a question about an order, call +45 42 42 26 84 or reply to your order confirmation.
lukket: My account is not open right now. Your orders and saved designs are unchanged. If you have a question about an order, call +45 42 42 26 84 or write to tilbud@neminventar.dk.
side.404: This page does not exist. If you are looking for your order, use the link in your order confirmation, or call +45 42 42 26 84.
side.fejl: That did not work. Try again in a moment, or call us on +45 42 42 26 84.
